Purely Global --- # LSP - Static Powder Applicator ### Advantages of Static Powder Applicators for Cables - **Excess Powder Avoidance:** The machine avoid excess powder application on the cable, thus maintaining the diameter of outer surface and avoidance of lump on the cable. - **Clean Shopfloor:** This machine doesn't allow the powder to spread on the shopfloor because of its design, does maintaining a clean environment. - **Coating Consistency:** The machine helps the cable to be used for further processes smoothly, since the powder is applied on consistently. The user gets enhanced experience during processes like stripping where if there is excess powder it may result in causing dirt on shopfloor and when there is less powder it might cause insulation tear-out. - **Low Air Consumption:** The machine uses less air consumption, thus saving on the cost of production. - **Usage of Powder:** Since there shall be consistent application of powder, the user shall have the optimal usage of powder thus saving cost of production. --- ### Key Features of Static Powder Applicators for Cables - **Powder Moisture Control:** LSP has inbuild heater to maintain the temperature of the powder which avoids the powder to be impacted by moisture, especially needed in coastal areas of India. The temperature is settable as well. - **Line Speed Synchronisation:** The machine shall automatically get synchronised with the line speed of the cable, there is no need of any line speed feedback. Thus, making it the easy for integration with your machine. - **Technology:** Our technological approach to achieve the consistent quality doesn't have dependency of air, thus avoiding any dust or moisture impact when the powder comes in contact with the cable ensuring consistent coating. With the electro static principal the user shall always get consistent results in their output as compared to the conventional designs. - **Design of Machine:** The machine is designed in way to ensure usage of less space on the shop floor. The airtight design ensures that the powder doesn't fall when the application process is going on, thus maintaining cleanliness on the shop floor. The machine also has a special environment at the exit to ensure the excess powder drops in the machine which gets reused again thus enhancing the efficiency of powder used and also adding to additional protection against clear shop floor. - **Troubleshooting:** With the intelligent control system, the user can see all the alarms and also take preventive action against the same. With the log of those alarms the maintenance team can also analyse their preventive maintenance action efficiently. - **Filters and Other Precautions:** The LSP is equipped with the best in class products which ensures consistency in performance and avoid any dust to be applied with the powder. - **Easy Maintenance:** With the use of quality parts the maintenance of the machine is very easy and simple.
